subject: SERVICER
notes: Contract amount SGD 1,000,000; the client withheld 100,000 at 10% and obtained the withholding certificate; amounts are in Singapore dollars.
The payment and withholding dates are not given in the case; 2025-12-31 is taken; this only affects the start of the refund and mutual agreement clocks.

The onshore performance share is unknown: 76 days of work in the Mainland are known and most of the work was done in Singapore, so performance in both places is a fact, service_onshore_share is left empty, and the Mainland deemed-profit base takes an interval for the share.
Whether the Singapore certificate of residence (COR) has been obtained is not given, residence_cert is left empty; the treaty exemption and the refund both depend on it.

The Singapore partial exemption (s43(6B)) is computed on the company's taxable income for the whole year; the case only gives this project's revenue of 1 million and costs of 0.7 million, so cit_rate is not filled and the 17% headline rate applies; profit_margin 30 is this project's margin.
service_kind is ENGINEERING_DESIGN_CONSULTING (data analysis, modelling, system implementation and training belong to design consulting, Article 5 of 国税发〔2010〕19号, 15%–30%).
The contract transfers no patent, copyright or know-how and the client does not get the source code; whether it is characterised as a royalty is a discretion item (Articles 4 and 6 of 国税函〔2009〕507号).
Meridian actually received 900,000 = contract amount − 10% enterprise income tax, with no VAT withheld; any withheld VAT is borne by the client, hence vat_borne_by_payer = true.
